personnel_transfer.rule: Approved petitions create physical personnel movement. A materialized officer remains one conserved force body; intra-force reassignment changes formation allocation only, while cross-force, foreign-service, allegiance, and ownership changes require their separate authorities.

officer_emergence.rule: Battle performance accumulates relevance on the exact persistent formation. Crossing the relevance threshold may materialize one already-conserved formation member; pressure is reduced rather than globally capped so later generations can still emerge.

autonomous_crisis.rule: Only formations already routed into instability attention are reviewed. State and House wakes page their exact owner indexes; they never scan every formation in the world.

knowledge.rule: An officer may evaluate only information personally held, shared-service evidence, or a lawful military-institution dossier delivered to that officer. Cross-state discovery requires sufficiently propagated public reputation, and hidden dossier details are not attraction inputs.

invariants: No commander receives player-specific attraction logic.
Career preference and petition state never own office, formation, manpower, equipment, or administrative custody.
State allegiance and House/patron loyalty remain separate pressures; neither silently rewrites the other.
A state officer remains a state officer unless the existing authoritative allegiance or appointment mechanism changes that fact.
Career petitions request action; approved movement executes through physical transfer orders and conserved force/formation accounting.
Formation loyalty is aggregate cohort-scale state on the persistent formation owner; named people retain exact personal state.
Carried field ration shortages affect loyalty only in field/mobilized postures; explicit starvation or supply-collapse evidence remains authoritative everywhere.
Administrative ownership never changes merely because loyalty or effective command allegiance changes.
Scalar loyalty summaries are non-authoritative for military allegiance resolution.
Materialization must reclassify an existing conserved person or cohort member and never create manpower.
Routing pages bound work per wake but never cap total officers, commanders, petitions, formations, career events, emergent officers, or allegiance crises.

Crisis allegiance resolves through state, institution, House/patron, immediate command relationships, named officers, aggregate internal officers, and formation identity rather than a single conversion threshold.
